description: Parmalat, LINKS Foundation and Nextworks publish anonymised production-scheduling requests collected from October to December 2023. Each JSON entry describes production quantity, priority, anonymised production area, last accepted change timestamp, unit of measure and item format. The knowlEdge collection platform and historical storage supplied the records, and its quality-assurance component anonymised the identifiers. Zenodo provides parmalatAnonymizedData.txt free under CC BY 4.0. These requests can support experiments on changing production priorities and industrial demand scheduling. The deposit does not identify the geographic coverage or facility location, full timestamp precision or mapping back to physical production lines. Anonymisation limits direct interpretation of the original products and resource units. The archived file was not downloaded, so its schema is taken from the publisher's description. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified.
